The '''Houche system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sugai sector/Legends|Sugai sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Houche]].
